A Digital-First Approach to Land Management The cornerstone of this reform is the complete digitalisation of the allotment process. This shift aims to eliminate discretionary practices and improve accountability in industrial development. BIADA has been directed to maintain the following allocation ratios within industrial zones: 55–65% for industrial plots. 15–25% for road infrastructure. 10–33% for green and open spaces. The policy represents more than an administrative reform. It signals Bihar’s intention to position itself as a serious industrial destination operating under a transparent and rules-based framework. Under the leadership of Samrat Chaudhary, the state is banking on these reforms to drive manufacturing expansion, attract private investment, and generate employment opportunities.
